You made us dream, you made us believe, and you finally gave us the World Cup. 🏆🇦🇷 Thank you, Leo, for every goal, every tear, every celebration, and every unforgettable memory. No matter what happens after today, you will always be my GOAT. 🐐❤️ Thank you for everything, Lionel Messi. It’s not goodbye… it’s thank you. 😭🇦🇷💙
